post3_notes.what_for: The flows' full self-attention (one sequence, 12 heads x 128, bf16) through int8 Q.K^T and fp16 P.V kernels: pixal3d/modules/sage.py, switch PIXAL3D_SAGE (on by default after a first-use self-check; off = flash_attn, bit for bit as before). post3_notes.known_issue_of_this_build: post6 upstream fixed stale shared memory for key rows past the sequence end; in this build it only matters for sequences of 64 keys or fewer, which the fork never hands to it (sage.MIN_TOKENS 65)
